lcc_original: 挪亞就都照永恆主所吩咐的去行了。
notes: UNV '就遵著' carries both prefix tags (כְּכֹל, according to all); LCC splits this into '都' (כֹּל, all → <WAH03605>) + '照' (כְּ, according to → <WAH09003>), so the two tags are distributed across separate characters in reversed order relative to UNV attachment
LCC '永恆主' is its rendering of יהוה (UNV '耶和華'); <WH03068> attached normally
LCC adds directional complement '去' before '行了' with no Hebrew counterpart — left unannotated
